# Will the retailer accept this EDI file?

> Free EDI X12 file checker and reader for suppliers: finds wrong SE/GE/IEA counts and control numbers, UPC and SSCC check-digit errors, invoice totals that do not match the lines and broken ship-notice hierarchies, and translates 997 rejections. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
